audit.why: EVEN 5.5/10 against 49.02% over 614 games holds: you out-range him at every level, and the danger is a single Parallel Convergence stun into Phase Dive, not the lane pattern.

audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven phases[N].side rows read 'Skill' while content win[N] and the packet levelChart both read Cassiopeia for all seven.
audit.why: The page rendered two different answers to who wins each stage. The whys already describe you winning those stages, so the sides were the wrong half.
audit.corrected: phases[0..4].side and phases[6].side -> Cassiopeia, proposed as one atomic group.

audit.whatIsWrong: None of the four decisive interactions were stated: Miasma grounds Phase Dive, Chronobreak makes him untargetable and heals him off damage you dealt, Parallel Convergence both stuns and shields, and Phase Dive is an auto-attack reset whose wind-up is the tell.
audit.why: Enemy E is flagged dash + autoReset; R is flagged untargetable + heal; W is flagged hardCC + shield. Your W text: 'Grounded enemies cannot use Movement abilities.'
audit.corrected: Ground the roll, force the shield out, hold final damage until Chronobreak resolves, and buy Grievous Wounds.

audit.why: Chronobreak 110/80/50, Phase Dive 9/8.5/8/7.5/7, Parallel Convergence 22/20/18/16/14, Timewinder 9/8.5/8/7.5/7 are the numbers the advice hangs on — note Chronobreak drops to 50s at rank 3, which is why late commits need it tracked.

audit.corrected: Bodies rewritten against Phase Dive, Parallel Convergence and the R's facing rule.

edits.after: W changes the geometry: Miasma GROUNDS dashes. Drop it where Phase Dive wants to land and his 325-range roll goes nowhere.

edits.before: - Ekko Chronobreak: matchup-defining — Erases your kill and bursts back — track the hologram and save final damage for after it. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your R Petrifying Gaze like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Chronobreak: 110s at rank 1 but only 50s maxed — he goes untargetable and heals, so hold your last fangs until he lands. - Phase Dive is 9s at rank 1 and Miasma grounds it. - Parallel Convergence stuns and shields on a 22-second timer.

edits.after: Miasma grounds Phase Dive, so drop it where he means to land — grounded, his 325-range roll goes nowhere and the fangs keep ticking.

edits.before: Q the last-hit window, E-E-E while the poison ticks, and walk back as it fades — three fangs and out, repeat until Ekko is executable.
edits.after: Petrifying Gaze stuns only enemies facing you — meet the Phase Dive head-on and he freezes; turn away and he is merely slowed.

edits.before: Ekko whiffs Chronobreak and the lane briefly belongs to you.
edits.after: Timewinder is 9 seconds at rank 1 — poke him for every whiff.

edits.before: That is Ekko’s whole plan in one window — decline politely and watch it retire.
edits.after: Miasma is the one thing that denies Phase Dive — spent on minions, the dive arrives free.

edits.before: Your miasma is the anti-dive — spending it on poke means the next engage arrives ungrounded and you have no boots to run.
edits.after: Facing away turns Petrifying Gaze into a slow — meet his Phase Dive and the stun lands before Parallel Convergence does.

edits.before: Spamming unpoisoned fangs at full mana cost, or holding W so long the dash you were saving it for already happened.
edits.after: Phase Dive returns in 9 seconds at rank 1 — chase him past your cloud and he warps straight back onto you ungrounded.

edits.before: Ekko wins by landing Chronobreak, denying your pattern, and front-loading the violence while your kit is still stretching.
edits.after: Ekko wins by stunning you inside Parallel Convergence, landing Phase Dive on top, and rewinding out through Chronobreak.

edits.before: Carry by DPS — no mid matches your damage-per-second from two items; your job is staying alive long enough to prove it.
edits.after: Carry with anti-heal and patience: Chronobreak heals off the damage you just dealt, so buy Grievous Wounds and finish after it.
